chain.description: Chain, e.g. Base, Ethereum, Gnosis. Required when the stage is measured on more than one chain — series are never blended across chains. Omit for venue-level rows.

grain.description: 'weekly' (the citable series, default) or 'daily' (the trend grain; never a headline).

mode.description: 'stage' (default) is one venue/chain/stage series. 'movers' is the week's Sato Score movement across the directory — which listings rose, fell, crossed a tier, were scored for the first time, or answered our daily checks differently. In movers mode venue, chain and stage are ignored.

stage.description: Lifecycle stage, e.g. registered, launched, settled_to_catalogued_seller, mcp_endpoint_answers. Required in 'stage' mode.

venue.description: Venue id, e.g. erc8004, olas, virtuals, x402, erc4337_accounts. See onchain_agent_get_agent_economy for the catalogue.
